headline: Gutter Erupts and Palantine Berm Stirs Anew
war_summary: Gutter, absent from the last edition, has burst into motion with thirteen flag actions inside two hours, the newest logged at the very minute of filing, Lost Kaivo its busiest post. Palantine Berm has rejoined the ledger as well, four transfers in two hours around Windburn Landing and Vendett. The Nevish Line's toll keeps climbing — near 720 Colonial and 640 Warden in two hours — its movement still fixed on Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother, and Tomb Father. Callahans Passage answers in kind, nearly 1,360 combined casualties in the same span, yet its map shows no transfer in a full day. Linn Mercy's flags have stirred again at Outwich Ranch, Weathered Expanse keeps trading posts around Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest, and Stlican Shelf logs fresh casualties though its flags last moved just after one. Ash Fields posts a sudden rise, twenty-seven Colonial casualties in two hours, without a flag event. Godcrofts remains the day's busiest ledger at forty-six actions despite thirteen hours of silence, while Marban Hollow has slowed to a trickle. The war stands in its 634th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, neither banner yet claiming it.
